name: Paint-Ready Ridge Fluted Panels
summary: Primed white MDF with raised half-round flutes routed into the face and five coats of primer sanded flat. A PVC film on the back adds rigidity; there is no veneer or felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: Ridge has nine convex half-round flutes at 1.31 in pitch, 0.29 in relief and 0.35 in total thickness; this tile spans nine pitches (11.79 in, versus the stated 11.80 in panel width) by 23.58 in. Neutral primed-white color follows the main photo and specified sanded primer finish, with subtle primer texture and no wood grain, veneer, felt or dark backing.
